Previous Core alternatives remain only in the superseded historical architecture record.

wire_panels.note: New engineering proposal: Core GPIO → ULN2003AN → AQY212GS LED, isolated contact pins3/4 to configured machine run circuit. This slow process interface does not implement E-stop, STO or PWM. Verify startup inactive, receiver mode/current, isolation layout and loaded off-state leakage before use. Nominal 390 Ω limits LED to approximately 5.5–9 mA using conservative 4.75 V supply, 1.5 V LED and 1.1 V sink drop assumptions; recheck tolerance/temperature and actual sink voltage. AQY212GS recommended LED5–30mA, contact≤48V/1A at25°C, derate by temperature; measured receiver current must fit. Contact is bidirectional and galvanically isolated from the LED side: no logic ground crosses that barrier.

target_options.smoothiebox: SmoothieBox enclosure plus V2 Core is the supported direction when retaining the four DQ860 power stages. The housing/carrier must expose verified Core P1 STEP/DIR and ground contacts.
target_options.core: Recommended controller for this machine: Core provides four STEP/DIR channels; add two TI SN74LVC07A open-drain buffers only if measured driver input current, pull-up, supply reference and return meet the device datasheet. Driver signal common to −36 V relationship is not documented.
target_options.prime: Not recommended for the documented 36 V/large external-driver architecture as a replacement power stage. Prime motor outputs are winding power, not STEP/DIR; a Core-compatible STEP/DIR peripheral would be required to keep DQ860s.

parts: Two TI SN74LVC07A open-drain six-channel buffer ICs; verify guaranteed sink current and exact DQ860 input current before wiring.
Retain four DQ860-family drives, four motors, 36 V/10 A supply, 12 V/10 A supply, WJ200, filter and physical NOT-Aus/relay chain pending nameplate/current verification.

OPA197 U3 SOIC-8 analog stage parts (R1 10kΩ, C1 10µF, Rf 20kΩ, Rg 10kΩ) are an unisolated engineering proposal; alternatively select a documented isolated PWM-to-0–10 V product matching configured PWM.
A separately selected opto-relay/dry-contact interface for the WJ200 FW input; no direct 3.3 V GPIO into P24/PLC input circuit.

Proposed run stage: TI ULN2003AN DIP16, Panasonic AQY212GS SOP4, 390 Ω LED resistor and 10 kΩ GPIO pull-down; separate PCB isolation layout required. Slow process command only; never substitute for safety chain.
instructions: Verify exact plan revision against fitted cabinet, every DQ860 suffix/current/DIP setting, WJ200 model and spindle nameplate.
Trace each motor to its driver and identify winding pairs by continuity with power isolated; keep +36 V/GND power wiring on driver only.

Build/review U1 and U2 SN74LVC07A buffers with VCC pin14=3.3 V, GND pin7=the individually identified Core J5.19 reference, and exact input/output pins shown in the diagram. Compare DQ input current to TI guaranteed output-low test point; if unknown or over spec, choose a rated isolated sink module.
For WJ200 analog speed, verify 0–10V O-L input, exact analog return, selected voltage input/source parameters, output range and grounding; run must be separate configured FW contact.
Identify all nine switch contacts and relay contacts individually; prove hardwired E-stop and guard behavior independently before motion commissioning.
